CodeIP.definition: Compare the decoded and target message prefixes up to the number of message units available at the generated length; the result is exact prefix equality.
CodeIP.replay_mapping: CodeIP-inspired indexed-survivor agreement: accept iff all surviving sites match their original indexed targets, with zero survivors accepted vacuously. Interior erasure changes the target to a subsequence, not the original contiguous prefix. Existing available_prefix output keys retain their historical names; they do not report literal public-prefix scores.

STONE.definition: Average correctness, detectability, and perplexity-based naturalness after the public implementation's component transformations.
STONE.replay_mapping: No numeric score is produced because the diagnostic benchmark has no admissible perplexity-based naturalness component. Automatic source similarity is not substituted.

SWEET.definition: Compute AUROC from negative and watermarked z-score arrays and report TPR at FPR bounds of zero, one percent, and five percent.
SWEET.replay_mapping: Watermarked z scores come from observed match counts. Negative scores are the exact fair-bit binomial null pooled over the observed surviving-site distribution.

SrcMarker.definition: Report mean per-bit agreement and exact recovery of all payload bits.
SrcMarker.replay_mapping: Per-bit agreement divides matching sites by the declared 24-bit payload, so deleted sites count as incorrect. Exact recovery requires all 24 sites to survive and match.

scope: Public definitions and explicit local adaptations are distinguished above. External source code is not redistributed, and the full external watermark systems are not executed.
